local: Inputs are processed locally in your browser.
tooLarge: Input is too large or processing took too long. Try a smaller input.
tooDeep: Over 30 nested levels or 5,000 tree nodes. Reduce the input.
recordsOnly: Enter a nonempty JSON array of objects.
csvInvalid: Invalid CSV: check quotes, empty or duplicate headers, and column counts.
invalidNumber: Enter valid numbers; numeric lists do not accept expressions.
identifier: Table and field names must use letters, numbers or underscores and cannot start with a number.
scalarOnly: INSERT supports only strings, numbers, booleans and null.
isoRequired: Enter an ISO timestamp with Z or an offset, such as 2026-09-24T09:00:00+08:00.
cronFields: Enter a five-field Cron expression or six fields including seconds.
invalid: Cannot process the input. Check its format.
csvHint: JSON to CSV accepts object arrays, serializes nested values and guards formula prefixes. CSV to JSON uses the first row as headers and keeps cells as strings to preserve leading zeros; nested types are not automatically restored.
ignoreSpace: Ignore spaces and tabs (keep line breaks)
hasChanges: Changes found: − marks original content; + marks new content.
identical: Contents match under the selected comparison settings.
sqlHint: Generate and format SQL locally without connecting to a database or executing queries.
sqlInputHint: IN and field lists accept newlines, commas or tabs. INSERT accepts a JSON array of objects. Review dialect, column types and target table before use.
isoHint: ISO input must include an offset or Z. Results use the selected time zone.
cronHint: Build and inspect Cron expressions. This page does not schedule actual jobs.
cronFieldsHint: Five fields: minute hour day month weekday. Six fields add seconds first. Quartz year fields are not supported. Results are strictly after the start instant and include UTC for DST checks.
storageHint: Entries stay in this browser. Export backups regularly; they do not sync automatically across devices.
invalidImport: Invalid or oversized import. Use an exported JSON file (up to 1,000 entries and 5 MB).
saveError: Save failed. Check the content and browser storage.
readError: Cannot read local entries. Writes are disabled to preserve existing data.
mergeHint: Imports merge by ID, keeping the newer entry for matching IDs and preserving other entries.
title: Title
regexTimeout: Regex timed out and was stopped. Simplify the pattern or shorten the sample.
regexHint: Matches update automatically with offsets, capture groups, named groups and replacement output. Up to 500 matches are shown; execution stops after one second. Favorites are stored in the knowledge base.
